Lemon Peel Powder for Food, Beverage and Personal Care Brands

Lemon peel powder is dried, finely milled lemon zest that gives a bright citrus flavour and aroma in dry form. Tradenest Naturals is a lemon peel powder exporter based in Surat, India, supplying bakeries, beverage brands, seasoning blenders and cosmetic formulators. As a lemon peel powder supplier india buyers can deal with directly, we focus on steady quality, clear specifications and dependable export paperwork. The peel is sourced from trusted growers and carefully selected before processing. It is cleaned, dried and milled under hygienic conditions, and each batch is coded for traceability. The result is a free-flowing powder that keeps the zesty character of fresh lemon peel and stores well when kept sealed.

Processing and Manufacturing

Our dried lemon peel powder is made by dehydration and mechanical grinding. Selected lemon peels are washed, sorted and then dried at controlled temperatures. Gentle drying helps keep the natural citrus oils that carry most of the aroma and flavour. Once dry, the peel is milled and sieved to a uniform 80-100 mesh. This fine, even particle size blends into dry mixes and disperses well in liquids and other formulations without clumping. The standard product is peel only, with no added colour, synthetic flavour or preservatives.

Key Specifications and Quality Control

Every batch is checked for moisture, mesh size, colour and aroma before packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Typical parameters for our standard export grade are:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh for a smooth texture.
  • Moisture Content: Below 7.0% to limit caking.
  • Purity: Single-ingredient lemon peel with no added fillers.
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing pale yellow to light green powder.
  • Flavor Profile: Zesty, bright and clearly citrus, typical of fresh lemon peel.

Applications Across Several Industries

Our bulk lemon peel powder wholesale supply serves a range of buyers. Bakeries and confectioners use it for citrus notes in cakes, cookies, glazes and icings. Beverage brands add it to herbal tea blends, instant drink premixes and craft brewing. Spice and seasoning companies use it in lemon pepper, rubs and dry marinades. In personal care, it appears in face masks, scrubs and handmade soaps. Supplement and herbal blend makers also include it in their dry formulations for flavour and aroma. This range of uses makes it a handy ingredient for product developers who want natural citrus character in a stable dry form.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for lemon peel powder exporter?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Private label and custom packing projects may need larger quantities, which we confirm at the quotation stage.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer food-grade packaging from 1 kg stand-up pouches to 25 kg export bags and HDPE drums. Shelf life is 24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place.

Contact our sales team through the website with your quantity, packing preference and destination. We will arrange samples and send a quotation together with the product specification sheet.
